summary: V29.av verification — BUGS 6/7/8. Backend Contact + ContactUpdate models correctly extend with energy_ref_name/phone/email (BUG 7): 3/3 pytest passed (create+persist, update+persist, empty defaults). Frontend /contact/new page renders correctly and all required testIDs are present in DOM: c-birth-date-web (BUG 6 web HTML5 date picker), c-energy-ref-name, c-energy-ref-phone, c-energy-ref-email (BUG 7). 'REFERENTE ENERGIA' section title visible in screenshot with the 3 fields fillable. BUG 8: /contact/[id].tsx source confirms the old big 'Codice cliente' card is removed from top (line 637 comment) and replaced by a compact inline row (codeCompactRow, line 1090) at the bottom of the info tab only, with testIDs contact-code-input and contact-code-save. However, end-to-end UI form submission could NOT be exercised because the login button on the web preview does not fire the login handler (no /api/auth/login request seen after auth-submit-button click), so POST /contacts always returns 401 in the browser session. This is likely a pre-existing web-preview auth issue and NOT introduced by V29.av (it does not affect native/APK). Backend tests use the demo user login endpoint successfully, so backend/auth are fine.

integration_issues.issue: Clicking [data-testid="auth-submit-button"] on /login does not fire onPress: no POST /api/auth/login is issued, URL stays on /login. Reproduced 3 different ways (mouse.click on bounding box, Playwright click force=True, Enter key on password field). AsyncStorage token injection into localStorage / IndexedDB (RCTAsyncLocalStorage) is not picked up either — app reload keeps user unauthenticated. This blocks end-to-end web submit tests of /contact/new (POST /api/contacts returns 401 in the browser). NOTE: c-save-btn on /contact/new DOES fire onPress correctly and DOES issue POST /api/contacts — confirming other Pressables work. Only auth-submit-button is inert. Not verified whether this is pre-existing regression or environment-specific.

action_items: BUG 6/7/8 code fixes are verified in source + DOM + backend. No changes needed for the 3 bugs.

Investigate the web-preview login regression: [data-testid="auth-submit-button"] onPress is not firing on the preview URL. Check if `doAuth` throws synchronously, if `busy` state is stuck, or if a global overlay is intercepting pointer events (Toast/FAB/Assistant). Confirmed backend login endpoint works via curl, and c-save-btn Pressable clicks work — so it's specific to this Pressable/page.
Once web login is fixed, rerun full E2E on /contact/new to submit a real contact via UI and confirm the 3 energy_ref fields round-trip through the browser.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/app/contact/[id].tsx is 1395 lines — over the 700-line threshold. Consider splitting into focused sub-components (tabs into own files).
/app/frontend/app/contact/new.tsx is very large as well (2000+ lines). Same recommendation applies.
